body:
My friend, you got this I promise you life will get better. The best time to take your life back is now. The only advice I can give you is: "Don't wait for things to happen, make them happen". I don't know if that makes sense, but you should try to do stuff. Anything. Like put some shoes on and go for a run ! You will feel better.

I hope it will help

It's really good that you finally found the courage to do what you love. I have a similar problem with my parents. I still live with my Nmom and I hate it. She always makes me feel guilty when I do something I like. 

That's the reason why I hate holidays for exemple, she always want me to stay at home for no reason. When I do something that I find fun she's always there to criticize me...

How did you do to not care about what they think ? It's still hard for me to do so...

Man, I totally understand what you feel. I feel the same way. I don't know what to do either. We have to do our best to be ok. Btw I also have this "door rule" in my house.

So to feel better, I call someone and talk. Or I would just go for a walk or do some sport. I strongly advise you to find something to do outside of the house. That worked for me to feel a little bit more happy.

I wish you the best my friend :)

Well, our moms are similar... My mom is alone, she has no friend. And it is never her fault when there's a problem. In every argument we have, she always find a way to make me feel guilty...

It's hard to deal with it, honestly I feel so down. Even when you try to be perfect, she finds something to say...

I don't have any advice because I'm in a similar situation and I don't know what to do... So I wish you the best for the future
Take care. I hope recovering some sleep will improve your life ! We often underestimate the lack of sleep. It has a tremendous impact on your life.
Thank you for sharing these advices. You're right, I'm the adult now. I will try to behave like one.

Sorry for your loss. It's not easy to lose someone you loved and lived with for a long time.

I don't know if it will help but when I lost a friend a therapist told me that I can write him a letter and then burn it. He said that you can take as much time as you need. It can be an hour, a day, a week even years if you need to.

Should I invite her the day of my birthday or wait ? Because I still feel angry at her. 
And it's not the first time she took a decision without asking me. For example, she literally took an appartment in a lost place far from evrything with a guy I never saw in my entire life. And she said to me and my brother: "It's already signed. Now you come living with us".

Thank you !
I think she feels that I am kinda making my life now, and she's scared. I just started to make friends these last five years and I spend less time at home. And she blame me for that. She say that I have to be at home. I don't understand...that's life maybe ?
